recipes.label: To Reforge This Part of Myself?
recipes.startdescription: This portion of power is too severely damaged to restore—but what is destroyed can be reforged. [Provide a 'Strength' card and a Forge of at least tier 12 to recover Heath.]

recipes.label: To Reforge a Permanent Wound?
recipes.startdescription: The wound runs too deep, beyond what flesh can mend—but I can reforge this body of mine, and the injury will vanish as my form is reshaped. [Provide a 'Strength' card and a Forge of at least tier 12 to remove an Unhealing Wound.]

recipes.label: To Reforge What Was Ruined
recipes.startdescription:
I will temper strength into this flesh amid raging flames, making it as tough and resilient as before.

[This will restore you, but you may only do this once per Foundry.]

recipes.label: Fading Flame
recipes.startdescription: Though purified by baptism in fire and born anew, the heat and might of my workings are more than any mundane workshop can bear—
recipes.description: To recover further strength, I will likely need to seek another place for my labors.

recipes.label: Create A Cunning Thrown Weapon?
recipes.startdescription: The core principles of different weapons share similarities—if I have a weapon as reference, supplemented with sufficient Edge and a touch of Winter and Knock, I can craft an ancient thrown weapon. [Provide no less than 14 levels of Edge and 7 levels of Knock and Winter to create a disposable Sacred Weapon. Notably, this recipe also requires at least 1 weapon, 1 Supply, and 1 Influence.]

recipes.label: Create A Cunning Thrown Weapon
recipes.startdescription: Edge ensures basic lethality, while the rites of Winter and Knock grant it a cunning that bypasses extraordinary defenses and a poison potent enough to pierce flesh and bone.

recipes.label: Create A Cunning Thrown Weapon
recipes.description:
This will be especially effective against tough, tenacious enemies.

[This is a Piercing weapon that can be acquired repeatedly, but each piece can only be used once.]

recipes.label: Craft a Molten Object of Strife?
recipes.startdescription: If I have a weapon as a reference, along with sufficient Edge, a small amount of Forge and Grail, I can craft a wild object of strife. [Provide at least 12 levels of Edge, 6 levels of Forge and 6 levels of Grail to produce two supplies with 'Molten' aspect. Notably, this formula also requires at least 1 weapon, 1 Supply, and 1 Influence to participate.]

recipes.label: Craft a Molten Object of Strife
recipes.startdescription: Edge is the essential principle for objects of strife, Forge shapes the form, and Grail grants life.

recipes.label: Craft a Molten Object of Strife
recipes.description:
This will be particularly effective against enemies with extraordinary defenses.

[Items with the 'Molten' aspect can nullify an enemy's 'Buffering' and 'Twisting' during an attack.]

recipes.label: Craft a Piercing Object of Strife?
recipes.startdescription: If I have a weapon as a reference, along with sufficient Edge, a small amount of Lantern and Winter, I can craft a piercing object of strife. [Provide at least 12 levels of Edge, 6 levels of Winter and 6 levels of Lantern to produce two supplies with 'Piercing' aspect. Notably, this formula also requires at least 1 weapon, 1 Supply, and 1 Influence to participate.]

recipes.label: Craft a Piercing Object of Strife
recipes.startdescription: Edge is the essential principle for objects of strife, Winter deepens endurance, and Lantern enlightens wisdom.

recipes.label: Craft a Piercing Object of Strife
recipes.description:
This will be particularly effective against those tenacious and hardy enemies.

[Items with the 'Piercing' aspect can nullify an enemy’s 'Resistant' and 'Revival' when attacking.]

recipes.label: Refining A Volatile and Hazardous Substance?
recipes.startdescription: By adding additional Forge along with an appropriate measure of Edge and Winter, one can refine Bitterblack Salt from ordinary Forge materials. [Supply no less than 12 levels of Forge, 4 levels of Edge, and 4 levels of Winter to produce two portions of Refined Bitterblack Salt. Notably, this recipe also requires at least 2 Supplies and the use of a tool.]

recipes.label: Refining A Volatile and Hazardous Substance
recipes.startdescription: Forge unleashes the potential of the fuel, while Edge and Winter enhance its resilience.

recipes.label: Refining A Volatile and Hazardous Substance
recipes.description: They will later stir even more fascinating transformations.

recipes.label: Craft Some Basic Ammunition by Myself?
recipes.startdescription: These days you really have to handle everything on your own. [Provide at least 10 levels of Edge and 6 levels of Forge to create two Alloy Projectiles. Notably, this recipe also requires a minimum of 2 Supplies and one tool to participate.]

recipes.label: Craft Some Basic Ammunition by Myself
recipes.startdescription: Infuse more Edge to enhance sharpness, and apply a touch of Forge for basic shaping.

recipes.label: Craft Some Basic Ammunition by Myself
recipes.description: This will grant me more leeway in the journey ahead.

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Evoke Vitality?
recipes.startdescription: When the power of Heart is sufficiently strong, I can compress the pulsation of rebirth into a small vial of preparation for future use. [Requires at least 12 levels of Heart to produce a higher‑grade Heart ingredient. Specifically, this formula also requires at least 1 Ability, 1 Supply, and 1 Influence to partake.]

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Evoke Vitality
recipes.startdescription: When the power of Heart is sufficiently strong, I can compress the pulsation of rebirth into a small vial of preparation for future use.

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Evoke Vitality
recipes.description:
I can use it as an aid in overcoming challenges, or simply enjoy its effects for myself.

[Using this resource grants a 'Strength' card.]

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Stir Passion?
recipes.startdescription: When the power of Moth is sufficiently strong, I can compress the buzzing fervor into a small vial of preparation for future use. [Requires at least 12 levels of Moth to produce a higher‑grade Moth ingredient. Specifically, this formula also requires at least 1 Ability, 1 Supply, and 1 Influence to partake.]

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Stir Passion
recipes.startdescription: When the power of Moth is sufficiently strong, I can compress the buzzing fervor into a small vial of preparation for future use.

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Stir Passion
recipes.description:
I can use it as an aid in overcoming challenges, or simply enjoy its effects for myself.

[Using this resource grants a 'Whimsy' card.]

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Induce Epiphany?
recipes.startdescription: When the power of Lantern is sufficiently strong, I can compress the searing radiance into a small vial of preparation for future use. [Requires at least 12 levels of Lantern to produce a higher‑grade Lantern ingredient. Specifically, this formula also requires at least 1 Ability, 1 Supply, and 1 Influence to partake.]

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Induce Epiphany
recipes.startdescription: When the power of Lantern is sufficiently strong, I can compress the searing radiance into a small vial of preparation for future use.

recipes.label: Craft A Preparation to Induce Epiphany
recipes.description:
I can use it as an aid in overcoming challenges, or simply enjoy its effects for myself.

[Using this resource grants a 'Revelation' card.]

recipes.label: Forging Art: Creations of the Corrivality?
recipes.startdescription: Given sufficiently strong Edge, paired with a measure of Forge or Winter, I might be able to replicate some creations made specifically for the Corrivality…

recipes.label: Forging Art: Ammunition?
recipes.startdescription: To produce ammunition in bulk, I still need sufficiently strong Edge or Forge.

recipes.label: Forging Art: Preparations?
recipes.startdescription: To craft preparations, I still need sufficiently strong Heart, Lantern or Moth.

recipes.label: Forging Art: Blending Ingredient and Influence
recipes.startdescription:
Now I need tools to shape the outcome. Or, by unleashing more abilities, I can craft something that may ignite my own potential in the future…

[Commit a card with the Tool, Weapon, or Ability for further guidance.]

recipes.label: Forging Art: More Ingredient?
recipes.startdescription:
These materials are already enough to produce ammunition in bulk, but I still need a Tool for assistance.

[Commit a card with the Tool aspect for hints on manufacturing ammunition, or use more cards of other kinds to attempt crafting different items.]

recipes.label: Forging Art: Influence?
recipes.startdescription:
The difference between the Invisible Arts and mundane labor is that the former can properly channel forces beneath the skin.

[Commit a card with the Supplies aspect for further guidance.]

recipes.label: Forging Art: Ingredient?
recipes.startdescription:
Even the greatest craftsman cannot create something from nothing. That is why these materials are needed.

[Most recipes require Supplies to participate. Commit more Supplies or cards of other kinds for further guidance.]
